evidence: GeO2 films were deposited in an F-120 (ASM Microchemistry Ltd.) ALD reactor using O3 as oxygen source (flux 365 SCCM (SCCM denotes cubic centimeter per minute at STP) and concentration of 160– 170 g / m3). The divalent Ge compound (dpp-BIAN)Ge, used as Ge source, is a monomeric two-coordinate Ge derivative. A 10-s-long purge in N2 is enough to eliminate ligand residuals and reaction byproducts after both (dpp-BIAN)Ge and O3 injections.
